title: Service Level Schedule Note — Depth of the Availability Shortfall
content:
The depth of the shortfall below the commitment raises the service level credit for the latest census month under the Paystride Earned Wage Access Program Agreement. The shortfall is the tier's availability commitment less the month's measured availability on the census:

- where it is at least 0.5 percentage points, the credit percentage is multiplied by 1.3;
- where it is at least 0.25 but below 0.5 percentage points, by 1.15;
- otherwise it is not multiplied.

The tier commitments are 99.5 percent on Starter and Growth, 99.7 on Professional, 99.9 on Enterprise and Enterprise Plus, and 99.95 on Strategic.

## Boundary cases on a commitment of 99.9 percent (hypothetical)

| Measured availability | Shortfall in points | Multiplier |
|---|---|---|
| 99.40 | 0.50 | 1.3 |
| 99.41 | 0.49 | 1.15 |
| 99.65 | 0.25 | 1.15 |
| 99.66 | 0.24 | none |

On a Strategic commitment of 99.95, a month measured at 99.45 is 0.50 points short and takes 1.3.
